validation_scope: local primary-review fragment index, post-summary visibility and receipt recovery; one live GitHub/DeepSeek fixture

covered_risks: merge-base/head identity, rename old paths, deleted and new files
disjoint source ranges exclude omitted gaps
initial clipping and repository text resembling a clipping marker
partial reads and long search hits do not claim complete lines
exact deduplication with separate version identities
native SDK compaction retains references without claiming literal source
bounded records, origins, JSON bytes and Python AST metadata
Git LF locations with Unicode separators and CRLF
symlink diff metadata excluded from regular code coverage
completed separate-process resume preserves index, requests and usage
completed receipt before graph failure replays one read

limitations: small new-file live PR; long-context and partial-output boundaries use controlled tests
request records prove assembled input, not model understanding or successful processing of failed requests
quality, cost and duplicate-read gains have not been measured
index covers primary review; verifier maintains separate read records
business Actions workflow has not been upgraded to this implementation
CLI resume needs matching extra model parameters; thinking-mode is not automatically restored
